title: Firni
hookLine: Global-inspired firni with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Firni
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour 1 cup of milk into a small bowl, add the cornstarch and whisk them well until smooth. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m53399_1}, {m53399_2}, {m53399_3}, and {m53399_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure whole milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Firni
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the rest of the milk into a non-stick saucepan, adding the sugar and cardamom (and rosewater, if desired) whilst cooking over medium heat. Incorporate {m53399_5}, {m53399_6}, and {m53399_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Firni
steps.instructionTemplate: Before it starts to boil, slowly add the milk and cornstarch mixture to the pan, whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Keep stirring until the mixture increases in thickness.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Firni
steps.instructionTemplate: Take the pan off the heat and pour into a large shallow serving bowl. Let it cool at room temperature, and then put in the refrigerator for about 1 – 2 hours.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Firni
steps.instructionTemplate: Finally, sprinkle your Firni with sliced almonds and pistachios and serve! Let Firni cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
